CannotSetPastExpiry(uint64).notice: Label expiry cannot be before now.

TransferDisallowed(uint256,address).notice: Transfer is not allowed due to missing transfer admin role.

TokenRegenerated(uint256,uint256).notice: Token was regenerated with a new token ID.         This occurs when roles are granted or revoked to maintain ERC1155 compliance.

TokenResource(uint256,uint256).notice: Associate a token with an EAC resource.

balanceOf(address,uint256).notice: Returns the balance of a token for an account.

balanceOfBatch(address[],uint256[]).notice: Returns the balances of a batch of tokens for an account.

canUpgradeFrom(address).notice: Declares this implementation as an eligible verifiable proxy upgrade target.

findTokenId(string).notice: Fetches the token ID for a label.

getAssigneeCount(uint256,uint256).notice: Returns the number of assignees for the roles in the given role bitmap.

getResolver(string).notice: Fetches the resolver responsible for the specified label.

getState(uint256).notice: Get the state of a label.

getSubregistry(string).notice: Fetches the registry for a label.

grantRoles(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Grants all roles in the given role bitmap to `account`.

grantRootRoles(uint256,address).notice: Grants all roles in the given role bitmap to `account` in the ROOT_RESOURCE.

hasAssignees(uint256,uint256).notice: Checks if any of the roles in the given role bitmap has assignees.

hasRoles(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Checks if the given account has been granted all the given roles in the given resource or the `ROOT_RESOURCE`.

hasRootRoles(uint256,address).notice: Checks if the given account has been granted all the given roles in the `ROOT_RESOURCE`.

isApprovedForAll(address,address).notice: Returns the approval for all operator.

isContractNamer(address).notice: Determine if an account is authorized to name this contract.         Called by reverse registrars.

latestOwnerOf(uint256).notice: Get the latest owner of a token.         If the token was burned, returns null.

ownerOf(uint256).notice: Returns the owner of a token.

revokeRoles(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Revokes all roles in the given role bitmap from `account`.

revokeRootRoles(uint256,address).notice: Revokes all roles in the given role bitmap from `account` in the ROOT_RESOURCE.

roleCount(uint256).notice: Returns the role count bitmap for a resource.

roles(uint256,address).notice: Returns the roles bitmap for an account in a resource.

safeBatchTransferFrom(address,address,ui.notice: Transfers multiple tokens from one address to another.

safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256.notice: Transfers a single token from one address to another.

setApprovalForAll(address,bool).notice: Sets the approval for all operator.

setURI(string,address).notice: Set the URI for the registry.

uri(uint256).notice: Returns the URI for a token.

userdoc.notice: UUPS-upgradeable `PermissionedRegistry` designed to be deployed as a proxy via         `VerifiableFactory` for user-owned subdomain registries. The constructor disables         initializers on the implementation contract; proxies call `initialize()` to set up the         admin and initial roles. Upgrade authorization requires the upgrade role in the root resource.
